hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Saturn Omnichain project. Implements only afterInitialize (as a no-op stub returning the selector) and exposes an initializePools() function that delegates to an external ISaturnOmnichainLiquidityBootstrapper to bootstrap liquidity and record the initial tick. No swap, liquidity modification, or donate logic is active.
